name: Tokiya Rei
source:
Formed Sub-Couple 03 with [url=/c128228]Koigawara Mia[/url].

Outside, he is undoubtedly a good-looking man, if a little arrogant. But on the inside he is a narrow-minded weirdo.
Has no desire to cooperate with others and always does whatever he pleases. He is filled with a strange self-confidence, you could call him an ultimate positive thinking monster.
Obviously, he has no girlfriend or even a friend and is constantly talking to himself.
The only good thing about him is his appearance, so he has personal beliefs on recognizing a wench who approaches him for his looks.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.asa-pro.com/koibana/character/subcouples.html]official website[/url]]
